title: PocketBase
descript: PocketBase is an open-source backend in a single file: SQLite database, realtime subscriptions, auth, file storage and an admin UI. This package runs the Docker Hub image as a non-root container and keeps the database and uploaded files in the application data folder. Only the x86_64 package is built because the upstream image does not publish an arm64 variant.
important: Open the web UI and create the first admin account; the root URL redirects to /_/. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/pocketbasedocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
